catalog.fullName: Steering wheel Adjustment lever- Reach & Accessibility
catalog.acceptanceCriteria: 1.Steering Wheel Tilt / Telescopic Lever should be reachable for all populations ranging from 5’00” to 6’03” in buckled condition without stretch from their respective seating positions.
catalog.procedure:
1.The Steering Wheel Tilt/Telescopic Lever shall be reachable and operable by all intended users, ranging from a 5th percentile female (approximately 5'0") to a 95th percentile male (approximately 6'3"), while in a seat-belted condition and seated in their respective driving positions, without requiring excessive stretching, forward lean, or posture deviation.

2.For accessibilty the design requirements should met required clearances.(Refer Image)

catalog.acceptanceCriteria:
1.Rim Cross Section	  Rim cross section should be within the requirement for comfortable grasping
2.3-9 O'clock Position Profile  Top side - Rim to switch joinery should be smooth and under flushed to avoid palm pinching /Bottom side - Rim to hub joinery should be curvy for adequate grasping
3.Thumb & Palm Grasping Profile    Rim to switch joinery should have circular relief and smooth profile for thumb insertion and palm grasping
4.Palm swell Profile	  Rim should have a swell for adequate palm grasping at 10 and 2 o’clock position 
5.Other Spoke Joineries	  Spoke joinery with rim should have adequate clearance to avoid finger entrapment
catalog.procedure:
1.Rim Cross Section: The steering wheel rim cross-section shall comply with ergonomic requirements to ensure a comfortable and secure grip during vehicle operation.

2.3 and 9 O'Clock Grip Position Profile:

Upper Side: The transition between the rim and switch housing shall be smooth and flush or slightly under-flush to prevent palm pinching and discomfort during use.
Lower Side: The transition between the rim and hub/spoke shall feature a smooth, contoured profile to facilitate a comfortable and natural hand grip.

3.Thumb and Palm Grasping Profile: The interface between the rim and switch housing shall incorporate adequate circular relief and smooth surface transitions to support comfortable thumb placement and palm grasping.

4.Palm Swell Profile: The steering wheel rim shall incorporate palm swells at the 10 and 2 o'clock positions to enhance grip comfort, control, and hand support.

5.Spoke-to-Rim Joineries: All spoke-to-rim transitions shall provide sufficient clearance and smooth geometry to prevent finger entrapment and ensure comfortable hand movement around the steering wheel.

catalog.acceptanceCriteria:
1.ACCESSSIBILTY - Steering Wheel Switches should be within the reach zone target for comfortable usage
2.BUTTON SIZE & SPACING -Steering Wheel Switch buttons should meet the button size and spacing requirement
catalog.procedure:
1.Accessibility:
 Steering Wheel Switches shall be positioned within the comfortable reach envelope of the driver, enabling easy access and operation without hand overextension, grip repositioning, or loss of steering control during normal driving.

2.Button Size and Spacing:
 Steering Wheel Switch buttons shall comply with established button size and spacing requirements to ensure accurate identification and operation, while minimizing the risk of accidental activation and supporting comfortable use across the intended user population.

For accessibilty the design requirements should met required clearances.(Refer Image)

catalog.procedure:

catalog.requirement:
1.Front visibility (Z Limit)
2.Side Visibility (X Limit)
3.Front visibility (Y Limit)
4.Front visibility (Y Limit wrt Eye Mid)
5.Accessibility
catalog.acceptanceCriteria:
1.Sunvisor coverage at fully open condition shall meet architecture target. Angle A = -1° to 2°.
2.Sunvisor coverage @ fully open condition to meet architecture target B pillar to Sunvisor X distance = 80 to 100
3.Sun Visor width Y >390
4.Architecture standard target (Lower Tumble Angle Vehicles) 
Eye mid to LH  Coverage = 205 - 215
Eye mid to RH Coverage = 180 - 190
5.Finger access clearance - Headliner with sunvisor 
Type 1 – Finger gap G= 15mm /  Length L – 90mm
catalog.procedure:
1.Open the sunvisor to the working position and measure Angle A. Verify that the angle is within -1° to 2° to provide the required front visibility coverage.
2.Open the sunvisor and measure the distance between the B-pillar reference and the sunvisor edge. Verify that the distance is between 80 mm and 100 mm.
3.Measure the effective width (Y) of the sunvisor and verify that it is greater than 390 mm to achieve the required visibility coverage.
4.Measure the coverage distance from the eye midpoint to the left-hand (LH) and right-hand (RH) edges of the sunvisor. Verify that both dimensions are within the specified ranges.
5.Check that sufficient finger clearance is available between the headliner and sunvisor for easy operation. Measure finger gap (G) and length (L) as applicable and verify compliance with the specified requirements.

4.Hood Reach Accessibility: Users shall be able to comfortably reach the hood top edge in the open position for hood opening, closing, and under-hood maintenance activities.

catalog.evaluationParameter: Lit Components Reflection on Windshield, ORVM & Sunroof
catalog.fullName: Lit Components Reflection on Windshield, ORVM & Sunroof
catalog.acceptanceCriteria:
1.Lit components of IP reflection should not fall in driver critical field of view(A zone) in windshield
2.Lit components of IP reflection should not fall in driver critical field of view in ORVM
catalog.procedure:
1.Reflections from illuminated Instrument Panel (IP) components shall not appear within the driver's critical field of view (A-Zone) on the windshield. Such reflections shall not distract the driver or obstruct the view of the road, traffic signs, pedestrians, or other critical driving 
information.

2.Reflections from illuminated Instrument Panel (IP) components shall not be visible in the Outside Rear View Mirror (ORVM). Reflected images shall not interfere with the driver's ability to clearly observe rear and adjacent traffic, ensuring safe visibility during driving.

catalog.acceptanceCriteria: 1.During Day and Nigh Unlit components of IP reflection should not fall in driver critical field of view in windshield  & If reflection falls, Driver’s Vision should not get distracted
catalog.procedure: 1.During day and night conditions, reflections from unlit IP components shall not appear in the driver's critical field of view on the windshield. If reflections are present, they shall not distract the driver or impair forward visibility.

catalog.fullName: Ambient Light reflection on Cluster & Infotainment

catalog.procedure: 1.Evaluate IP and Door Trim ambient light reflections on the windshield, side glass, and ORVM under street-light conditions. Reflections shall not cause distraction, glare, or obstruct the driver's critical field of view.

catalog.fullName: Instrument Cluster Direct Sunlight through Windshield
catalog.acceptanceCriteria: 1.There should not be any direct sunlight falling on Cluster Screen through windshield, whenever vehicle is travelling from West to East  & If direct sunlight falls on cluster screen , there should not be any visual obstruction for driver on the screen
catalog.procedure: 1.Direct sunlight through the windshield shall not fall on the instrument cluster screen during West-to-East vehicle travel. If sunlight exposure occurs, all displayed information shall remain clearly visible and legible, without glare, reflections, or screen washout that could obstruct the driver's view or cause distraction.

catalog.fullName: Infotainment Screen Direct Sunlight through Windshield
catalog.acceptanceCriteria: 1.There should not be any direct sunlight falling on infotainment Screen through windshield, whenever vehicle is travelling from West to East  If direct sunlight falls on infotainment screen , there should not be any visual obstruction for driver on the screen
catalog.procedure: 1.Direct sunlight entering through the windshield shall not fall on the infotainment screen during West-to-East vehicle travel. If direct sunlight exposure occurs, all displayed information, including text, symbols, graphics, and icons, shall remain clearly visible and legible. Sunlight-induced glare, reflections, or screen washout shall not cause visual obstruction, reduce readability, or distract the driver during vehicle operation.

catalog.acceptanceCriteria: 1.No Reflection through Day Light Opening (DLO) should be visible in the Cluster to avoid driver distraction / visual obscuration.
catalog.procedure: 1.Reflections originating from the Day Light Opening (DLO) shall not be visible on the instrument cluster display. If reflections are present, they shall not distract the driver, obstruct the display, or impair the visibility and legibility of cluster text, symbols, tell-tales, graphics, and critical driving information under any lighting condition.
